features.name: Bonus Feat
features.description: Gain a bonus combat feat. Fighters get another at every even level.

features.name: Bravery
features.description: +1 bonus on Will saves against fear, increasing by 1 every four levels after 2nd.

features.name: Armor Training
features.description: Reduces armor check penalty by 1 and raises armor's maximum Dex bonus by 1. Improves every four levels after 3rd. Allows normal speed in medium armor at 3rd level and heavy armor at 7th.

features.name: Weapon Training
features.description: Choose a weapon group for +1 attack and damage. Improves every four levels after 5th, and you choose a new group at 9th, 13th, and 17th.

features.name: Armor Mastery
features.description: Gain damage reduction 5/- while wearing armor or using a shield.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Choose one weapon. Its attacks automatically confirm critical hits, its critical multiplier increases by 1, and it can't be disarmed.
